messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: P0 - High error rate from inference API in us-west-2a. 80% 5xxs detected, latency spikes. Auto-runbook triggered. @oncall

emma_dev: seeing a bunch of ECONNRESET in the inference logs, clients losing keepalives

raj_sre: confirming. NLB target health is flapping for several instances in us-west-2a. TCP RSTs on upstream. Load balancer still routing -> spikes of 502/504.

jordan_oncall: patched in — I'm joining. tagging infra: @raj_sre @maria_eng. impact: customers with region pinned to us-west-2 see errors for inference/predict endpoints, streaming sessions drop.

maria_eng: adding detail: kernel-level netdev errors on host i-0a12... complaining about tx timeout and NIC reset. AWS support case opened (case 123456789).

emma_dev: stack traces show short lived failures during KV cache fetches which then cause retries to fail fast - tokenization requests get aborted. Repro: curl to /v1/stream returns connection reset ~30s after connect.

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-03-15-az-path-flap. Severity P0. Runbook: start failover to secondary region -> start.

raj_sre: immediate mitigation plan:
- mark unhealthy targets out of NLB target group (manual deregister)
- enable cross-region routing rule for us-west-2 -> us-west-1 (via routing policy on edge)
- increase capacity in us-west-1 dedicated pool for inference

jordan_oncall: doing deregister now. command:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0a12...
```

jordan_oncall: deregistered 4 hosts, waiting 30s for connections to drain. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sales_csm: FYI, Sales mentions two paying customers on dedicated capacity in us-west-2; they reported customer-facing errors. I'll open a support bridge and ping accounts after stabilizing.

emma_dev: after deregistering, error rate dropped from 80% to ~12% but latency still elevated. Looks like some requests still hitting misrouted endpoints due to DNS TTL and client-side reuse of endpoints.

raj_sre: noted - Route53 health check hasn't flipped yet; edge caches still have old endpoints. Forcing a failover via edge: updating traffic policy to prefer us-west-1 for inference.* subdomain. Rolling now.

maria_eng: kicked autoscaling in us-west-1, spun up 6 extra instances, warmed models and KV caches. Observability shows token throughput normalizing.

jordan_oncall: after edge flip, 5xxs dropped to single-digit %. Some long tail due to TCP RSTs from existing connections; recommending clients backoff/retry semantics.

ops-bot: Post-action: manual reroute executed, hosts removed, cross-region capacity increased. Please annotate timeline for postmortem.

emma_dev: customers on sticky sessions (session affinity via NLB cookie) still saw errors for ~10 minutes because existing TCP connections reset and client SDKs didn't reconnect to new region.

raj_sre: mitigation for sticky sessions: we pushed a quick SDK patch to retry on ECONNRESET with exponential backoff and prefer new endpoint resolution. Patch deployed to hosted SDK (v1.8.3).

sales_csm: sent initial status update to affected customers, offered credits for token usage during outage window. Customers appreciated timely updates.

maria_eng: AWS support responded: possible underlying hypervisor NIC bug causing transient host NIC resets in one AZ. They are investigating hardware path. We coordinated host replacement for affected hosts.

jordan_oncall: handoff to night SRE @raj_sre in 30m. Next steps documented in incident channel. Will collect pcaps and NIC logs for AM analysis.

emma_dev: action items for postmortem:
- timeline + root cause (NIC/hypervisor) + AWS RCA
- why Route53 health check didn't flip faster (thresholds)
- improve SDK default retry on ECONNRESET for streaming
- add runbook step to proactively rehome sticky sessions to healthy region

raj_sre: adding: consider lowering DNS TTL for inference endpoints to reduce cache hangover during AZ failover.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> degraded -> monitoring. Created follow-up tasks: TASK-9876 (postmortem), TASK-9877 (SDK retry), TASK-9878 (DNS TTL change).

jordan_oncall: final check: error rate now ~0.5%, latency within SLO. handing off to @raj_sre for overnight monitoring. :white_check_mark:

raj_sre: taking over. I'll keep watch and jump if AWS confirms further host impacts. Thanks team.
